# Assaf Elovic

> Builder of AI agents since 2015. Creator of GPT Researcher, co-founder of Tavily (acquired by Nebius, 2026), currently building Ora. Sequoia Capital scout investing in early-stage AI startups.

Personal site: https://www.assafelovic.com

## Background

- ServiceFriend (2015): Built conversational agents; company acquired by Meta. Granted US patent US10303758B2 for real-time automated conversational agents.
- Tiv.ai: Founder. Consumer productivity assistant on WhatsApp with 5M+ users worldwide. Y Combinator Startup School (2019).
- Wix: Built Wix's first AI agent.
- monday.com: Head of AI. Led the AI transformation across the company.
- GPT Researcher (2023): Creator. The first open deep research agent, 29k+ GitHub stars, cited by numerous academic papers. https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher
- Tavily (2024): Co-founder. The search engine for AI agents, 5M+ users worldwide. Acquired by Nebius in 2026. https://tavily.com
- Ora (now): Working on how agents can use businesses autonomously. Backed by Sequoia and Index. https://ora.ai

## Investing

Scout for Sequoia Capital. Investments include LangChain, Anthropic, Engram Labs, Delphi, PiLabs (acquired by Microsoft), Runhouse (acquired by Anthropic).
